description:
Hi,


This is Anthony from Infojini Consulting. Hope you are doing well! 


We are looking for .Net developer in Columbia, SC for 12 months Contract

 

 Job details mentioned below
Job Title:.Net developer 
Location: Columbia, SC
Duration: 12 months
Client : State of SC - Department of Health and Human Services




DAILY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:

This contract position is needed for maintenance, development and support for the Child Care Licensing System, and for the development and support of the 

integrated Child Care Services System Development (CCSS) project. The Integrated System (CCSS) is a project that is underway to replace several independent 

Child Care Systems (SC Voucher, ABC Quality, and the Child Care Licensing System) with a new framework that integrates multiple Child Care program functions and 

reporting into one system. The original design of the CCSS did not incorporate functions and reporting of the CACFP application. This position will also consult 

on the development and structure of the CACFP application to insure consistency for future integration of those functions of the CACFP System into the Child 

Care Integrated System.




 

 REQUIRED SKILLS (RANK IN ORDER OF IMPORTANCE): 

 C#.NET 
 VB.NET 
 ASP.NET 
 VISUAL STUDIO 
 TEAM FOUNDATION SERVER 


 CANDIDATE MUST BE ABLE TO COMMUNICATE CLEARLY WITH THE DEVELOPMENT TEAM, PROJECT STAFF, AND THE USER COMMUNITY.   


 STRONG PROJECT SKILLS 

 SELF STARTER 
 MINIMAL MANAGEMENT REQUIRED 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
